# Kieni’s Finest

> Heavy engineering and metal fabrication workshop in Nyeri and Nanyuki, Kenya. CNC laser cutting, lathe turning up to 7 m, milling, drilling, plate bending, pressing, welding, grinding and forging, with sourcing and tender support. Delivery across Kenya and to South Africa.

Contact: Pius Githinji, phone and WhatsApp +254 716 723 644.
Quotes: send a drawing, photo or sample with sizes and quantity. Quotes are usually the same day.
Service area: Nyeri, Nanyuki, all of Kenya, and South Africa.

## What we make
- Shafts and spindles: Ø20–600 mm, up to 7,000 mm long
- Rollers, bronze bushes, threaded bars
- Flanges and couplings up to Ø1,200 mm
- Base plates, welded frames, drilled steel beams
- CNC laser-cut plate blanks, flanges, discs and washers
- Forged shafts, hooks and tools

## Capacities
- Drilling: holes up to Ø50 mm, 2,000 mm reach
- Turning: 610 mm to 7,000 mm between centres
- Shaping and milling: flat to 0.02 mm, stroke up to 8,200 mm, CNC milling
- Bending: plate up to 80 mm thick, 200-tonne bender; pressing from 420 tonnes
- CNC laser: 6,000 W, plate to 40 mm, 6,500 mm bed; guillotine to 13 mm
- Grinding: to 0.01 mm (surface, pin and shaft grinders)
- Welding: arc, MIG, TIG, spot and laser; steel, stainless and aluminium
- Forging: Marsey forging hammer
